result: The latest stable holycodex release is v0.16.12, not v0.16.9-2. Neither tag's TUI uses OpenTUI Solid or tuiparts. The TUI is imperative `@opentui/core` text only. The notes file was not written because I have no Write tool.

**Tag (fact)**
- Stable releases at github.com/davidbasilefilho/holycodex/releases: v0.16.12 (a56aa72, 2026-10-03) is newest, then v0.16.11 and v0.16.10. v0.16.9-2 is older.
- The clone's `.git/refs/tags/v0.16.12` exists, but I could not check it out (no shell). I read v0.16.12 via raw.githubusercontent.com instead.
- At v0.16.12, `help.ts` and `TERMINAL_THEME` are byte-identical to v0.16.9-2.
- `installer-wizard.ts` differs only in structure:
  - An Effect wrapper, `runKeyInputScreen`.
  - Five capabilities instead of three (adds `session-audit` and `auto-reset`).
  - A windowed conflict list.
- Layout, glyphs and keys are unchanged. The values below hold for both tags.

**Holycodex TUI style**
- Framework: `packages/cli/package.json` depends on `@opentui/core`. The root catalog pins `~0.5.11` at v0.16.9-2 and `^0.5.14` at v0.16.12. `packageManager` is `bun@1.4.2`.
- Rendering: `createCliRenderer({exitOnCtrlC:true, clearOnShutdown:true})` with one `TextRenderable` whose content is `StyledText`. There are no boxes, borders or backgrounds.
- Theme: `packages/cli/src/help.ts` `TERMINAL_THEME` is Tokyo Night:

| Token | Hex |
| --- | --- |
| heading | #7aa2f7 |
| option | #7dcfff |
| argument | #a9b1d6 |
| focus | #7dcfff |
| enabled | #9ece6a |
| disabled | #a9b1d6 |
| success | #73daca |
| warning | #e0af68 |
| error | #f7768e |
| hint | #737aa2 |

- Emphasis: bold on `heading` and `focus` only (`nativeStyledChunk`).
- Colour policy (`colorEnabled`):
  - `NO_COLOR` set, or `TERM=dumb`: off.
  - `FORCE_COLOR` set and not `0`: on.
  - `CI` set and not `false`: off.
  - Otherwise on only for a TTY.
- Screen layout (`installer-wizard.ts`, `nativeWizardContent`):
  - Title `HolyCodex  ·  install` in heading tone.
  - Hint line `↑/↓ focus   ←/→ change choice   Space toggle   Enter review   Esc cancel`.
  - Blank line, then uppercase headings (`PROFILE`, `OPTIONAL CAPABILITIES`, `ADDITIONAL PLUGINS`).
  - Rows are `❯ ` (focused) or two spaces, then the label padded to 13 or 14 characters, then the value.
  - A trailing hint line describes the focused row.
- Glyphs: `❯` marks focus in the wizard, `›` in review menus and `>` in the conflict list. Checkboxes are `[x] enabled` and `[ ] disabled`.
- States: focused rows use `focus`; unfocused toggles use `enabled` or `disabled`. Review actions are green/amber/red when unfocused.
- Keys: up/down or j/k, left/right cycle choices, space toggles, Enter reviews, Esc or Ctrl-C cancels. The text field handles home, end, backspace and delete.
- Reusable: `help.ts` (`TERMINAL_THEME`, `colorEnabled`, `paintTerminal`) and the pure `apply*Key` transition functions.
- Tests mock `@opentui/core` with a fake renderer at 80x24 (`installer-wizard.test.ts`, about line 814).

**OpenTUI Solid and tuiparts (npm registry and opentui.com, as of 2026-11-07)**
- `@opentui/solid` and `@opentui/core` are both 0.8.3. The Solid peer is `solid-js ^1.9.12`; the docs advise 1.9.16 or later.
- Setup:
  - `tsconfig.json`: `jsx: "preserve"` and `jsxImportSource: "@opentui/solid"`.
  - `bunfig.toml`: `preload = ["@opentui/solid/preload"]`.
  - `bun add solid-js@^1.9 @opentui/solid`.
- Runtime: Bun 1.3.14 or later, or Node 26.4 or later with `--experimental-ffi`.
- Elements: `box`, `text`, `scrollbox`, `input`, `textarea`, `select`, `tab_select`, plus `span`, `b` and `strong`.
- Render and exit: `await render(() => <App/>, {exitOnCtrlC:false})`. Call `useRenderer().destroy()` to exit; destroying the renderer disposes the Solid root. `useKeyboard` handles keys.
- Headless testing: `testRender` from `@opentui/solid`, and `createTestRenderer` from `@opentui/core/testing`. The setup exposes `mockInput`, `renderOnce`, `captureCharFrame`, `captureSpans`, `waitForFrame` and `resize`.
- Windows: native packages exist for win32-x64 and win32-arm64. Core tests run on Windows x64. Windows arm64 needs Bun 1.4 or later.
- There is no npm package named `tuiparts` (404). The real packages are `@tuiparts/core` and `@tuiparts/solid`, both 0.0.6 (2026-08-05), with 21 weekly downloads.
- `@tuiparts/solid` ships unstyled primitives:
  - Button, Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, Switch, Radio, RadioGroup, Toggle, ToggleGroup, Tabs, Input, Textarea, Dialog, Accordion.
  - Recipes install through shadcn.
  - There is no multiselect and no Select; use OpenTUI's `<select>`.
- Conflict (inference): `@tuiparts/solid@0.0.6` peers are `@opentui/solid ^0.4.3`, `@opentui/core ^0.4.3` and `solid-js` exactly `1.9.12`. `^0.4.3` excludes 0.5.x and 0.8.3, so it will not satisfy the current OpenTUI or holycodex's `^0.5.14`. Pinning `@opentui/*` to 0.4.x would work but diverges from holycodex.

**T3 Code (pingdotgg/t3code)**
- `packages/contracts/src/settings.ts`: `DEFAULT_BROWSER_AUTO_SHOW_FLOATING_PREVIEW = true`. The setting is `browserAutoShowFloatingPreview` and defaults to true.
- `docs/user/devices.md` says an agent-opened device floats over the chat. Turning off Settings → Browser → "Auto-show floating preview" opens a right-panel tab instead. This is described for devices; the browser case is inferred from the code below and the `revealServerTabs` mirror copy.
- The setting is mirrored by `apps/web/src/components/preview/agentOpenedPreviews.ts`:
  - `revealServerTabs` skips a reveal when the setting is off, unless the reveal is forced.
  - When on, it opens the floating mini-player over the chat.
- The agent browser is not a fixed right-side pane. It floats over the chat by default. The right panel hosts preview tabs (`useRightPanelStore`, `surface.kind === "preview"`), which you reach with "Open in right panel" or by turning the setting off.
- I read the T3 source through mirrors and search excerpts (a git.cafe copy and a Forgejo mirror of the repo), not the GitHub checkout.
